videos.description:
A showcase of Jiuyuan's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

Jiuyuan's animations feel really floaty and flashy (in a show-offy kind of way, not bright), which took a while for me to get a proper feel for, but now I think I like them a lot more than I did initially.
Her personality, I feel, is VERY much showcased in her attack animations. Her calm and collectedness is very present in each attack, and in some, it even feels like she's more so just having fun, almost like she's dancing with her enemies (her burst shows that off REALLY well, and is THE best part of her animations).
As someone who's a sucker for the subtle parts of animations, I REALLY like how much she twirls her gun after most of her attacks. It just looks so satisfying each time. 9/10 for me

videos.title: Chaos Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills)
videos.description:
A showcase of Chaos' gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of his animations.

For a male character, I think Chaos has some really good looking animations, and could probably be on the top of my list. I say "probably" with a lot of weight on it, because, funnily enough, the problem IS the lack of weight behind any of his animations, which is a glaring problem that I feel holds back most of Chaos' animations.
The way he hits with his scythe-blade around FEELS like it should weigh a lot, ESPECIALLY since it looks like it's made fully of metal (or a metal-like material), but the way he moves it around, especially during the transitions back to his idle, make it look like it weighs NOTHING. That would be a good thing, if we were talking from a gameplay perspective, but from an animation POV, it kinda takes away from any of the impact any of the attacks would've had otherwise if they had any weight put into them.
Seeing the animations in actual gameplay is still really smooth, and the SFX do help a lot as well, so I think they were more focused on making his animations quicker (although weightless), just so they don't feel slow or laggy, which is fine with me. 7/10 for me.

videos.title: Lacrimosa Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills) | Neverness to Everness
videos.description:
A showcase of Lacrimosa's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

If I ranked characters by the amount of animations they have, then Lacrimosa would be 1st PLACE with how many animations they stuffed into her kit. But unfortunately, this feels a bit like a "quantity over quality" scenario.
Lacrimosa's animations feel very 'basic', in a way that's comparable to most of the standard characters we have now. Not necessarily bad, but nothing that special either. I guess you could argue that it fits into her character and personality, which I would actually agree with! Her little bits of animation after each attack, with her nodding off a bit I find really cute.
One itty bitty problem I have with her animations tho, are the fact that she barely has any facial expression, or any facial movement at all during her MELEE basic attacks. And though you could argue her full body animations are lackluster because of her character & personality, you can't say the same for her facial expression, SPECIFICALLY in this case, because she doesn't even look at where she's hitting. It's not really that big of an issue, but I really like observing all the details and animations of each character, and was disappointed that she barely has any facial expressions during most of her attacks. 6/10 for me.

videos.description:
A showcase of Daffodil's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

HUGE bias here (as a Daffodil main), but I think Daffodil has THE best animations in the game as of now.
Her basic attacks feel precise, strong, and very heavy. Yet, the way she moves her blades around shows how light they are in comparison.
I know not many people pay attention to all the animations after each attack (I personally LOVE seeing how each animation transitions to the idle), but I especially love how she readjusts her blades by either spinning them around, or lightly tossing them in the air, then catching them (which, again, shows how little they really weigh).
My favorite attack of hers (besides her attack dash, since it isn't really an "attack") would definitely be her enhanced Redirect Skill. It just feels REALLY strong, and the blade waves look very visually pleasing. And the animation for it is top-notch, with her using her chains to attach her blades to her heel, then her getting the blades back into her hands with said chains is just perfection.
Her burst has got to be the best one by far. The opening animation with her getting a burning eye, then hitting a killer pose while a BIGGER eye opens up behind her is just so cool. And even after that opening animation, the attack afterwards, with the rain of chains, and her just standing in the midst of it, pure AURA.
So... yeah. Pretty sure you get the idea on how much I love Daffodil. 11/10 for me.

They even added a PLUNGE attack for her ultimate, even though no one would even THINK of plunging during it (I fogor to showcase it cuz of that mb). The rest of her animations are just fine for me, but I also do like the way she floats with her umbrella after her basic attacks, which are just nice to look at. 7/10 for me.
